name: Magazarr
description: Magazarr is a magazine-only companion for Quasarr. It keeps a free-text magazine list, periodically searches Quasarr for recent issues, sends matching releases back to Quasarr for download, imports completed PDFs, and exposes the library through OPDS. Configure Quasarr URL, API key, search/import intervals, import root, library path, OPDS auth, and Discord webhook from the Magazarr Web UI after first start. Mount the same completed-download path used by JDownloader/Quasarr to /output. If JDownloader runs in a separate container, keep the host path and container path consistent so Magazarr can safely import and clean completed package folders.
